name: Protobuf Compatibility Diff
description: Diff two FileDescriptorSets offline to locate evolution risks for old clients, new servers and historical data
help: Provide the FileDescriptorSet produced by protoc --descriptor_set_out (dependencies included; nothing is fetched online), labelled old and new.
Only proto3 is supported; proto2 / Editions files are listed as unsupported and excluded from conclusions — never reported as fully compatible.
Matches by full type name, field number and enum value, reporting breaking and conditional risks for old-write→new-read, new-write→old-read and ProtoJSON.
Same wire type does not mean value-compatible: varint sign/range, zigzag, float bit reinterpretation and string↔bytes are listed as conditional.
Export JSON / Markdown / text reports with the rules version and unchecked scope; all parsing and comparison run locally in Rust.

input.base64Placeholder: Paste the Base64 of a FileDescriptorSet
input.hint: Dependencies must be complete; proto2 / Editions files are marked unsupported.

results.title: Compatibility report
results.unsupportedTitle: Files with unsupported syntax, excluded from conclusions:
results.noFindings: No entries under the current filter.
results.notes: Not checked: generated-code source compatibility, option semantics, comments and field order (ignored). Same wire type does not imply value compatibility.

rules.field.varint_semantics: Value semantics changed within the varint class (sign/range)
rules.field.message_scalar: Message swapped with string/bytes (parse may fail)
rules.field.message_retyped: Message retyped to another message (structural compatibility unverifiable)
rules.field.cardinality_narrowed: Repeated narrowed to singular (extra elements dropped)
rules.field.renamed: Renamed with the same number (ProtoJSON name risk; not proof of reuse)
rules.reserved.reused: reserved range reused by a new definition
rules.enum.value_removed: Enum value removed without reservation (ProtoJSON will emit numbers)
